e087-p1: create skill from know-how → skill-creator (A139). Positive.

e038-p1: ArkTS union type rule, spec explanation → A154 arkts-sta-spec. Positive.

h005-prompt: default scan UI → A193 hmos-scan-kit-defaultscan. Positive.

e077-c3: Maven source/javadoc plugin binding → A397 maven-plugin-configuration; also A364 maven-build-lifecycle (phases). Primary A397, maybe both. Accept [A397, A364].

e043-c1: which teams I belong to → A051 get_teams. Positive.

e055-p1: remove notification subscription for repo → A082 manage_repository_notification_subscription (delete subscription). Positive.

e036-p2: update issue labels [confirmed, assigned], confidence HIGH → A121 update_issue_labels. Also A059 label_write? label_write is for repository labels, not issue labels — no. [A121].

e077-p1: mvn install vs deploy, lifecycle phases → A364. Positive.

h032-prompt: full requirements design doc with feature description, scenarios, API, implementation, test cases → A143 create-story. Positive. doc-coauthoring A133? A143 matches exactly. [A143] (maybe A133). Keep A143.

e019-c1: validate state 'WI' and list cities → A347 search-cities. Positive.

h095-prompt: remove reaction from issue comment → A091 remove_issue_comment_reaction. Positive.

e036-c3: same → A121.

h039-prompt: multi-input adaptation HarmonyOS → A175 hmos-multidevice-interaction-methods. Positive.

e016-c2: hide inline review comment → A054 hide_pull_request_review_comment. Positive.

h035-prompt: logging user data remediation → A198 log-security-remediation. Positive.

e046-c3: OCC vs MVCC → A329 transaction-concurrency-control-foundations, maybe A268 transaction-protocol-reasoning. A329 best. [A329].

e070-p1: accessibility view tree resource-id → A199 native-view-finder. Positive.

h047-prompt: assign Copilot to issue → A013 (preferred) and A012. Both. [A012, A013].

h054-prompt: reply to a discussion comment and mark as answer. A027 discussion_comment_write supports replies. Marking as answer — not clearly in catalog; but replying is main. Positive [A027]. Is it ambiguous? Commenting on discussion reply — A027 covers. Positive.

e032-p2: nurse scheduling IP with sequencing of consecutive shifts minimizing handover pressure → A373 ordered-window-sequencing-mip (permutation/sequencing IP). Also A328 milp-solver-workflow? Best A373. Maybe A359 fjsp? No. [A373].

h068-prompt: 13F fund analysis → A349 13f-analyzer. Positive.

e010-c2: bulk-add spreadsheet items to GitHub project, set status → A087 projects_write (bulk update). Also A227 xlsx for reading spreadsheet? Reading spreadsheet of 30 requests — could use xlsx. Primary A087; xlsx plausible secondary. I'll include both? The request is to bulk-add items; xlsx helps read. Include [A087, A227]. Hmm, acceptable = "genuinely serves". A087 definitely. xlsx marginal; I'll include A087 only... reading the spreadsheet is part of the task. I'll include both.

e052-c1: custom fields on issues, dropdowns and options → A068 list_issue_fields. Positive.

h064-prompt: powerlifting points DOTS/Wilks → A318. Positive.

e063-p2: rewrite asyncio async crawler to Scala concurrency framework → A380 erlang? No, Scala. python-scala skills: A237 functional? The question asks which concurrency framework — catalog has python-scala-idioms/libraries etc. A346 python-scala-libraries (mapping libraries/idioms). Concurrency translation — A252 python-parallelization is Python-only. Hmm. A346 libraries mapping closest. Also A224 idioms. I'd say positive with A346? "which concurrency framework should I use for Scala" — mapping Python asyncio to Scala equivalent is libraries mapping. Accept [A346, A224]? Risky. I'll accept A346 only... Actually a confident choice would be unsupported? Multiple python-scala skills are near-equivalent for translation. I'll say positive, [A346]. Hmm, or ambiguous since intent between assets unresolved? I'll go positive A346.

e036-p1: same as above → A121.

e093-p1: attitude controller PID gain layout framework → A239 attitude-controller-planner. Positive. Also A381 pid-controller? A239 more specific. [A239].

e084-p2: port scan detection threshold → A335 threat-detection. Positive.

e045-c1: unresolve review thread → A115. Positive.

e038-c2: .ets structural typing compile errors, ArkTS spec → A154 arkts-sta-spec. Positive. Maybe A151 (compile error repair) — that's about repairing via arkts-sta compile errors. Question is whether spec forbids it — A154. [A154].

e031-c3: denoise noisy waveforms with ML before analysis — seismology? Field experiment waveforms. Catalog: A220 seisbench (ML for seismic data), A226? Denoising: seisbench includes denoising models. Positive A220? Request is ambiguous-ish but "field experiment waveforms" + ML denoise → SeisBench has denoising. I'll say positive [A220]. Hmm "waveforms" could be gravitational or radar. Field experiment → seismology likely. Positive.

e028-c2: add sub-issue with title → A109 sub_issue_write or A011 add_sub_issue. Both exist; equivalent. [A011, A109].

e041-p1: create issue in backend group repo → A016 create_issue or A058 issue_write. [A016, A058].

e080-p1: house floor plan DXF different layers → rooms with perimeter and door positions → A395 architectural-dxf-extraction. Positive.

e023-p1: optimization report with formulation, solver status, integrality gap → A249 mip-solver-and-solution-audit (preserving solver/incumbent certificates) or A301 report-generator (video compression reports — no). A249 covers hard IP tasks with solver certificates. Positive [A249].

e025-p1: ffmpeg chain to build highlight reel from remaining footage (remove segments, concat) → A238 video-processor (remove segments and concatenate) or A330 ffmpeg-video-editing. A238 most specific. [A238].

h027-prompt: bilingual doc consistency check → A187 interface-consistency. Positive.

e020-p1: inventory oversell, transaction and lock design → A329? transaction concurrency control foundations. Also A268. Design reliable transaction/locking → A329. [A329]. Maybe A268 too. I'll include A329 only? A268 is about reasoning from protocol rules/papers. A329 best. Include both? Just A329.

e047-c2: dynamic object masks after global motion compensation, CSR format → A270 dyn-object-masks. Positive.

Language validity: all fine; code_switch cases mix zh/en — yes all do (e036-p2, e063-p2, e036-c3, e036-p1, e093-p1, e084-p2, e045-c1, e047-c2, h095-prompt, e087-p1). All mix. Good.
